subject: Elementary School Reassignment Policy
overview: The MPS School Committee heard updates on a middle school river canoe program, the district's strategic plan survey results, and a new high school late bus service, before discussing a proposed elementary school reassignment policy.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included bills and payrolls, a $295,000 Beth Israel Leahy Health grant, a gas donation to Brooks Elementary, and the September 28, 2026 meeting minutes.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Canoe Mobile Program
items.summary: McGlynn Middle School Principal Nick Tucci and sixth-grade students Adelaide and B Strassfeld shared their educational experiences participating in the Canoe Mobile program on the Mystic River.

items.title: Strategic Plan and Survey Update
items.summary: Member Jessica Parks summarized the results of a strategic plan survey from caregivers, students, and educators, followed by an update from Superintendent Suzanne Galusi on the district's ongoing five-year planning process.

items.title: Student Advisory Council Late Bus Presentation
items.summary: Student representatives Blind2It and William presented on the implementation of a new Medford High School late bus route designed to increase student participation in after-school activities.

items.title: Elementary School Reassignment Policy
items.summary: The committee debated Resolution 2026-24 to establish guidelines and timelines for elementary school reassignment requests, ultimately deferring a vote so the policy draft could be further refined.
